headline: No more pop-ups or Output panel while agents work
pill: quiet rounds and a reload prompt
summary: Rounds no longer show a progress pop-up or open the Output panel, however they start. Everything shows in the chat. And a window still on the 0.2 layout after updating now says to reload instead of loading forever.
improvements: Rounds started with **Continue from Claude/Codex** or the Command Palette are as quiet as ones started in the chat: no progress pop-up (and no progress sound with accessibility signals on), no cancelled or error pop-ups, and the Output panel stays closed.
fixes: After updating from 0.2 without reloading, the old **Chat** pane no longer loads forever: it explains that the window needs a reload and has a **Reload Window** button.
